name: flowboard
description: BPMN editor with saved projects, version history, live collaboration and an AI assistant

scripts.start: vite build packages/web --logLevel warn && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning apps/standalone/src/main.ts
scripts.test: vitest run && vite build packages/web --logLevel warn && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:api: vite build packages/web --logLevel warn && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:api:postgres: vite build packages/web --logLevel warn && TEST_STORAGE=postgres node --test test/*.test.mjs
